parameters.content:
# START HERE: XB Kit Re-tagger (#269)

- **When:** daily 03:00 SGT (workflow timezone Asia/Singapore), or by hand with Manual Run.
- **Scope:** every ACTIVE product on the XB Shopify store. Only product tags change: the 30 kit tags `kit-<kit>` (8) and `ks-<slot>` (22) from the XT kit rules v1. `kit-no`, `kit-pin-<kit>`, unknown `kit-`/`ks-` tags and every other tag are never touched.
- **Hands-off (owner, 21 Nov 2026):** no routine email. A good run, a quiet run and a dry run send nothing. The only emails are errors, each one plain-English ERROR through **XB Ops Alert Email** (system `KIT-RETAG`), and the run then ends as failed.
- **Flow:** settings -> one access token -> read all active products (100 per page) -> work out the tag changes -> tag writes -> check them. Any problem -> one error email -> stop.
- **Never fights a person:** the workflow keeps a record (workflow static data `kitTagRecord`) of the tags it added or removed. A tag it removed that a person put back is never removed again; a tag it added that a person took off is never added again. Silent. Only scheduled runs keep the record (n8n does not save static data from manual runs).
- **Removal brake:** when the night's plan would take known tags off more products than normal (more than 10% of the products that carry one, and more than 10), nothing changes that night and one ERROR is sent. Adds are never limited.
- **Dry run:** `DRY_RUN` is on in this export. A dry run writes nothing and sends nothing: its plan is in the output of **Work Out Kit Tag Changes**, read by Claude at the live steps.
- **No saved executions** (the access token is in item data). Rules change only by a reviewed repo PR (`tests/fixtures/xb_kit_rules_v1.fixture`), never fetched at run time. Runbook: `docs/xb_kit_retagger.md`.

# Setup (local import copy only)

- Import inactive. **XB Ops Alert Email** must already accept system `KIT-RETAG` (re-imported first).
- Bind the Shopify app credential on **Get Shopify Access Token** only (type and fields: runbook). No other node has a credential.
- The first real run and activation each need their own owner OK.

## Required manual configuration:

- **Run Settings**
  - `SHOP_DOMAIN`: replace `REPLACE_WITH_SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN` with the store's myshopify domain (in the local import copy, never in the repo).
  - `DRY_RUN`: leave `true` until the owner OKs a real run; `false` at activation.
- **Send Kit Alert**
  - `Workflow`: replace `REPLACE_WITH_OPS_ALERT_EMAIL_WORKFLOW_ID` with the live XB Ops Alert Email workflow id.

# Read

- One token per run (client credentials grant, valid 24 h), retried up to 3 times.
- Active products, 100 per page, 1 s apart, at most 40 pages, plus Shopify's exact count of active products.
- A failed or throttled page or an incomplete read stops the run in the next step: no writes, one error email.

# Decide

- The kit rules are pasted in **Work Out Kit Tag Changes** (logic fields only).
- Mode: failed or braked (error email, no writes), dry_run (plan in the output only), no_change (quiet) or write.
- People's own tag changes are left alone (record in workflow static data).
- An unexpected Code error sends one error email (Build Unexpected Alert).

# Write

- One GraphQL request per changed product, 1 every 500 ms: `tagsAdd` and/or `tagsRemove` only.
- Retried up to 3 times (safe to repeat). Any HTTP error, GraphQL error or userErrors is a failed write.
- Check Write Results records what went through; all good -> no email; any failure -> one error email.
- After any error email, **End Run As Failed** stops the run so it counts as a failed run.
